text.hi: किताब: तुम अनुराग हो। घर के पास कुछ लोग एक हरा पेड़ काट रहे थे। अख़बार के संपादक को शिकायत का पत्र लिखो। शुरुआत: Sir, I would like to draw your attention to ... अंत: Yours truly।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: tum Anurag ho. Ghar ke paas kuchh log ek hara ped kaat rahe the. Akhbaar ke sampaadak ko shikaayat ka patra likho. Shuruaat: Sir, I would like to draw your attention to ... Ant: Yours truly.
text.en: The book: you are Anurag. Some people were cutting a green tree near your house. Write a letter of complaint to the editor. Begin: Sir, I would like to draw your attention to ... End: Yours truly.

steps.question: How do we end a letter to the editor?
